note: iOS-only UI strings, merged into localization.json by build/extract-i18n.js. Keys the web app already has are NOT repeated here — they come from js/i18n.js so the two apps cannot drift.

ios.rail.title: Jazz, from the top down
自上而下的爵士谱系
ios.rail.lede: Time runs downward. Tap a genre for its profile, or the branch button to collapse the list onto that genre and its direct influences.
时间自上而下流动。轻点流派查看档案，或点分支按钮，把列表收拢到该流派及其直接影响关系。
ios.rail.a11yHint: Opens the genre profile. Use actions to focus the lineage.
打开流派档案。使用操作菜单可聚焦谱系。
ios.rail.empty: No genres exist yet at this year. Drag the year slider forward.
该年份还没有任何流派。请把年份滑块往后拖。
ios.spans.title: Every genre, one bar each
每种流派一条时间带
ios.spans.lede: Proportional time: each bar spans 1890 to today, and the solid block inside it marks the peak years.
按比例呈现时间：每条带从 1890 年延伸至今，其中实心部分标示鼎盛年份。
ios.map.lede: The whole graph. Pinch to zoom, drag to move around it — the canvas is wider than the screen by design.
完整的关系图。双指缩放、拖动浏览 — 画布本就比屏幕更宽。
ios.detail.noLineage: No influences recorded for this genre.
该流派没有记录任何影响关系。
ios.detail.focusInRail: Focus this genre in the rail
在时间轴中聚焦该流派
ios.settings.offlineNote: Everything ships inside the app. No network, no accounts, no tracking.
全部内容随应用打包。无需联网、无需账号、不做追踪。
ios.settings.translationNote: Simplified Chinese covers the complete interface and all editorial prose. Official artist, record, track, person and label names remain in their canonical form for accuracy and streaming search.
简体中文覆盖完整界面与全部编辑文字。艺人、唱片、曲目、人物与厂牌的正式名称保留原文，以确保资料准确并便于流媒体搜索。
ios.settings.railNote.title: Why time runs downward
为什么时间自上而下
ios.settings.railNote: On the web, time runs left to right, which needs a wide screen. Held vertically, a phone has height to spare and no width, so the axis is rotated. In the rail, time is ordered and labelled rather than drawn to scale — at a readable row height a proportional axis would be mostly empty space. Proportional time lives in the Spans view.
网页版的时间轴自左向右，需要宽屏。竖持手机时高度充裕而宽度不足，因此把时间轴旋转了 90 度。时间轴视图按顺序排列并标注年代，而非严格按比例绘制 — 在可读的行高下，按比例的时间轴会有大量空白。按比例的呈现请看时间带视图。
ios.about.intro: A guide to how jazz genres descend from, react against and revive one another, and about 350 records to actually listen to. Built from the same hand-authored dataset as the web version.
一份关于爵士乐流派如何彼此传承、反叛与复兴的指南，以及约 350 张真正值得一听的唱片。与网页版使用同一份手工编写的数据集。
ios.about.accuracy.title: On accuracy
关于准确性
ios.about.accuracy: Album years, labels and catalogue numbers were checked against MusicBrainz and discographic sources; 279 of 351 had their release year confirmed to within a year. Entries marked medium or low confidence carry a note saying what is uncertain. Genre boundaries are arguments, not facts — every genre has a “contested” section saying where scholars disagree.
唱片年份、厂牌与编号已对照 MusicBrainz 与唱片目录核对；351 张中有 279 张的发行年份在一年误差内得到确认。标记为中等或较低可信度的条目附有说明。流派边界是争论而非事实 — 每个流派都有“争议”一节说明学界的分歧所在。
ios.about.links: The full source list, the verification log and a “known gaps” section live with the web version, in research/notes.md. The judgment calls are in DECISIONS.md.
完整的资料来源、核对记录与“已知缺口”一节随网页版提供，见 research/notes.md。所有取舍判断记录在 DECISIONS.md。
ios.about.credits: Streaming buttons are searches, not direct album links: album IDs cannot be derived from metadata, and guessed ones point at the wrong records.
流媒体按钮是搜索链接而非专辑直链：专辑 ID 无法从元数据推导，猜测的结果会指向错误的唱片。
ios.error.title: The guide could not be opened
无法打开指南
ios.error.detail: 无法读取应用内置的指南数据。
ios.error.hint: This usually means the app is damaged. Reinstalling should fix it.
这通常意味着应用文件已损坏，重新安装即可解决。
